question: What claim about the transmission of teaching is at stake in saying that the teaching of the mothers was again told by the sky-movers?
premises: It was told by the sky-movers to the goddess and beloved one.
inference: A teaching concerning the mothers was transmitted again by the sky-movers.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: Of the mothers again, O goddess, by the sky-movers it was told, O beloved one.
